Massively empower your body and infuse it with a flame aura. Allows you to go into a risky but overwhelmingly powerful berserker mode.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Flame Aura: Adds Flame Damage to the player's physical and aura attacks equal to 50% of their base damage. Costs 200 MP per attack. Increases Flame Damage by 2x.
Active
[Active - Press] Rage: Grants the player Strengthen 10 (20 with Mastery) buff for 5 Minutes on activation. Costs 300 MP
Active: [Active - Press] Mad Ogre: Grants the player a strength 15 (30 with Mastery) buff (doesn't stack with rage), doubles their size (+2 reach & +1 step height), gives them +0.4 (0.8 with Mastery) Knockback Resistance, +0.04 Speed, and gives them 20 (40 with Mastery) armors for 10 minutes. During the duration the player is inflicted with the Rampage Debuff. After the duration gives the player Fragility 2, weakness 2, and Paralysis 2 for 10 minutes. Costs 5,000 MP.
With Mastery, 6 spheres of fire spawn behind the player and on activation again, one will be sent flying towards where the player is looking, exploding and dealing 100 damage. When sneaking, the player can no longer send the orbs flying, but direct attacks from others landing on the player will trigger an orb to explode instantly and halve the damage that the player would take. The Flame Orbs will regenerate 20 seconds after being used in any way.

Passive
Grants access to the intermediate level of Light Spirit Magic
Active
[Active - Hold] - At the cost of 30 MP per 20 ticks held down and 50% speed, deal 2 holy damage and apply Nausea for all mobs within a 10x10 radius

Shoot black lightning at varying strength, or summon a massive storm which attacks any non-allied mobs. A short range plasma blast can also be used to melt even the strongest of foes.

Active
4 Modes. 1 Art. Anything besides Default requires Molecular Manipulation
Active: [Active - Press] - Default Power: Consumes 500 MP and fires a large bolt of lightning down on their cursor, dealing 50 Damage. Lights blocks on fire and turns sand into glass in a 20 block radius. 5 second cooldown.
Active: [Active - Press] - Decreased Power: Consumes 100 MP and fires a smaller bolt of lightning down that deals 25 Damage. Lights blocks on fire and turns sand into glass in a 10 block radius. 3 second cooldown.
Active: [Active - Press] - Increased Power: Consumes 1000 MP and fires a giant bolt of lightning that deals 150 Damage. Lights blocks on fire and turns glass into sand in a 35 Block Radius. 7 second cooldown.
Active: [Active - Hold] - Blast: Requires Mastery. Unleashes electricity in a beam-like radius up to 30 Blocks in-front of the user. Deals 50 Damage and costs 100 MP each second. Inflicts targets with paralysis II for 5 seconds on contact.
Active: [Active - Press] - Death Storm (Requires Wind Manipulation + Learning): When activated, changes the weather to stormy and any neutral or hostile mob within a 50x50 radius is considered a target. Every 10 seconds, every mob within range is hit with either a Black Lightning Strike or a Tornado automatically. Black Lightning deals 50 Lightning Damage and Tornado last for 10 seconds, moves the target up and deal 10 wind damage each sec. Lasts for a total of 60 Seconds and costs 5,000 MP. Stops if user is deep under a roof.

Command the tempest infused flames to spew out black flames at your enemies or even shoot deadly fireballs and hell flares.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Coating: On tools it grants an autosmelt effect (ores into bars, wood into charcoal); on melee weapons it grants a fire aspect effect; and on Bows it lights their arrows on fire. With Mastery, apply a debuff that blocks regeneration for 30 Seconds to the user's attacks. [5MP each Block-mined/Attacked-Hit]
Active
[Active - Hold] - Default: Unleashes Black Flames outward from the user in a breath/cone attack. Lights blocks on fire. Costs 50 MP per second and deals 20 damage per second.
Active: [Active - Press] - Projectile: Fires a Flame Charge-esc projectile that explodes on contact and deals 50 Damage. Costs 100 MP. [1 second cooldown]
Active: [Active - Press] - Hell Flare: (Requires Ranged Barrier, Ogre Flame and Flame Manipulation. Requires Learning): Launches a projectile on activation that creates a 30x30 Barrier where it lands. The barrier is filled with Black Flames that deal 300(800 with mastery) damage on spawn. The barrier and the flames last for 60 Ticks. Costs 2000 magicule to activate. [2 seconds cooldown]
Active: [Active - Press] - Limited Hell Flare: (Requires Hell Flare Mastery): Launches a projectile that creates a 5x5 barrier where it lands. The barrier is filled with black flames that deal 2500 damage on spawn. The barrier and flames last for three seconds. [1 second cooldown]

WIP

Passive
[Requires Mastery, Passive, Toggled] On Mastery, prevents Cook and Severance from being applied to the player.
Active
[Active, Hold] Constant: Health - Holding down the skill key will preserve your current health and spiritual health no matter how much damage you take. This mode drains 1000 magicules every second of is held down. When releasing, you will have a cooldown of 10 seconds,
After 15 seconds of holding this ability down, this mode automatically turns off with a longer cooldown of 15 seconds.
Active: [Active, Press] Constant: Physical - After pressing the skill key, begin a 5 second timer. It will record the highest physical hit you perform during this timer. After the timer has ended, [Constant: Destruction] becomes available to use. Puts the skill on a 10 second cooldown after the key is pressed.
Active: [Active, Held, Locked] Constant: Destruction - On the completion of Constant: Physical, become able to use Constant: Destruction. While holding down this skill mode, your damage will stagnate and always deal the highest hit you saved in Constant: Physical. This mode drains 3000 magicules every second it is held down. When releasing, you will have a cooldown of 10 seconds,
After 15 seconds of holding this ability down, this mode automatically turns off with a longer cooldown of 15 seconds.
Active: [Requires Mastery, Active, Press] Constant: Energy - For 10 seconds after pressing this mode, your Magicules and Aura will not deplete. However, it will begin a hidden counter. After the 10 seconds are up, the cost of all the abilities that you used will be added up and multiplied by two, then subtracted from each of your statistics accordingly. If the drain from this mode would exceed 0%, instead set your magicules to 25% and prevent regeneration of magicules for 3 minutes.
No English wiki description is available for this skill.

Collapse back into whence you came. Your memory is fleeting and the people you once knew start to forget you as well. Relapse and claim what belongs to you.

Currently has no uses.
Notes

Light your fists and weaponry ablaze."

Passive
[Passive, In Slot] Spark - Set your enemies when you attack them, akin to Fire Aspect. When mastered, upgrades to Fire Aspect II and becomes a Passive, Toggle.

Consume all in your path or have your rampaging subordinates do it. Corrode your enemies, devour their strength, and add their abilities to your own.

Active
[Active - Hold] Corrosion: Give user’s physical attack with a corrosion effect when this mode is in Slot. When activated while looking at nothing, costs 200 MP and deals 5 corrosion damage every 10 ticks to all enemies in a 10x10 radius. Enemies killed by this have their Intrinsic, Common, Extra, and Resist Skills taken by the player as well as have 20% (Configurable) of their ep added to the player's maximum. The other 50% is added to Stomach's energy storage. (25 to MP, 25 to AP) - (EP absorb only applies for the first target of that type using Starved)
Active: [Active - Press] Stomach: When activated, grants access to a spatial storage with the size of a chest with 6 rows. Items are able to be stacked to 128 instead of 64.
Active: [Active - Press] Receive: When activated while looking at a subordinate, Intrinsic, Common, Extra, and Resist skills owned by it are given to the player.
Active: [Active - Press] Spiritual Domination: Like Thought Communication + 1 additional command: Rampage. Activating Rampage command will give 5 minutes of Rampage effect to every subordinate in 30 block radius, activating again or using other commands will remove the effect.

Feast on the energy of your opponents. Steal mana with your attacks and become more powerful when killing others.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - When toggled, increases the amount of permanent EP gained when killing a target by 3% for both Aura and Magicule (+6% total), boosted to 7.5% each with Mastery (+15% total)
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] - Grants the player's attacks a 50% (75% with Mastery) chance to steal 1% of the target's current MP and restores their MP by that amount.
Active
[Active - Press] - When activated on a target with Fear V+ or current EP (not max) below 10% of the user's current EP, kills them and restores the player's EP by the target’s EP (splits 50% AP, 50% MP). This can set you above 100% AP/MP, so do be careful as going higher then 100% can give negative effects, such as Insanity for Aura, and Magicule Poisoning for Magicule.
has a 3.5 block range in front of user.

Absorb strength from enemies, buff yourself and debilitate your enemies.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Jealous Luck: 10% auto-dodge chance, Luck III, immune to Weakness and Slowness.
Active
[Active - Press] Absorb: Can only be activated on a target with a higher EP than the player - Success rate based on user’s EP / target’s EP: 10%, 10-20% => 20%, >20% => 30%. Attempt to lower the target’s EP to be the same as the player, with the difference being returned to the player. 50% of the EP absorbed this way is converted into Maximum EP and the other 50% is only temporary MP and AP. [60% of the time will take half the available EP, 40% of the time will achieve full effect - maximum amount is 1M EP] - 30s cooldown (10s with mastery).
Active: [Active - Hold] Strength Sap: In a 30x30 block radius around the user (Can be resisted if the user has 60% (80% with mastery) of the magicules of the target or more), applies 10 seconds of Weakness, Slowness for each 10% difference [50-60% level 1, 40-50% level 2, 30-40% level 6,..., 0-10% level 6]; also drain MP/AP at 0.1% per second of the affected entity which doesn't go to the user. Has 20% chance to increase 1 level of Insanity for the user (lasts 12s) every 10 seconds. Costs 1000 magicules per second.

Become tenacious and repair your body. Since magic and mana itself has rejected you, utilise your pure aura alone.

Passive
[Passive, Toggle] Tenacity:
Applies the Aura Healing effect. Instantly regenerate HP and SHP damage. Costs 100 AP per point of HP healed and 120 AP per point of SHP healed. Reduced to 60 and 80 respectively when mastered.
